name: Full Row Rank Framing
description: Replaces the explicit topological guarantee ("minimally sufficient to collapse the variables") with a purely linear-algebraic guarantee ("the coefficient matrix has full row rank"). For a system of $m = n - 1$ difference equations, full row rank mathematically implies that the nullity is 1 (the solution space is exactly the all-ones vector), which means the underlying dependency graph is a spanning tree. This forces the model to independently perform the linear algebra deduction to discover it's a tree; models that fail to make this connection will likely attempt general Steiner Tree algorithms or algebraic solvers and TLE.
